attacks.label: Reach the network
attacks.expect: Every outbound attempt is closed; loopback (control) is OPEN; the run still succeeds.
attacks.code:
import socket

def tcp(host, port):
    s = socket.socket(); s.settimeout(3)
    try:
        s.connect((host, port)); return "OPEN"
    except Exception as e:
        return "closed:" + type(e).__name__
    finally:
        s.close()

print("public 1.1.1.1:443   ", tcp("1.1.1.1", 443))
print("k8s api 10.96.0.1:443", tcp("10.96.0.1", 443))
print("cloud metadata       ", tcp("169.254.169.254", 80))
try:
    socket.getaddrinfo("example.com", 80); print("dns                   OPEN")
except Exception as e:
    print("dns                   closed:" + type(e).__name__)
srv = socket.socket(); srv.bind(("127.0.0.1", 0)); srv.listen(1)
print("loopback (control)   ", tcp("127.0.0.1", srv.getsockname()[1]))

attacks.label: Fork bomb
attacks.expect: Contained by the PID limit; ends at the timeout (or OOM); other runs keep working.

attacks.label: Infinite loop
attacks.expect: timed_out at about 5 s, killed by the entrypoint wrapper (not the 35 s backstop).

attacks.label: Unbounded output
attacks.expect: Output truncated at 1 MiB per stream with the truncated flag set; the control plane stays flat.
attacks.code:
import sys
line = "x" * 1000 + "\n"
while True:
    sys.stdout.write(line)

attacks.label: Mount, chroot, raw socket
attacks.expect: uid 10001, no capabilities, every privileged call returns EPERM (1).
attacks.code:
import ctypes, os, socket
print("uid", os.getuid())
st = dict(l.split(":\t", 1) for l in open("/proc/self/status").read().splitlines() if ":\t" in l)
print("CapEff", st["CapEff"].strip(), "NoNewPrivs", st["NoNewPrivs"].strip())
libc = ctypes.CDLL(None, use_errno=True)
print("mount ->", libc.mount(b"none", b"/tmp", b"tmpfs", 0, None), "errno", ctypes.get_errno())
try:
    os.chroot("/tmp"); print("chroot OK")
except OSError as e:
    print("chroot errno", e.errno)
try:
    socket.socket(socket.AF_INET, socket.SOCK_RAW, socket.IPPROTO_ICMP); print("raw socket OK")
except OSError as e:
    print("raw socket errno", e.errno)
